protocol_decision.claim_contract_label: light-v1 CT1 online transport-context UPS variant
protocol_decision.accepted_scope: May spend exactly one ledger-protected held-out confirmation after this pre-test contract passes validation.
protocol_decision.rationale: CT1 estimates the transport shift from one observed transition, which uses less context than the current CT8 claim config. It also applies roll-persistence from horizon 2 in the teacher-forced decoded evaluator, so any successful held-out result must be described as an online/context-conditioned protocol variant rather than an autonomous long-horizon rollout claim.
rejected_overclaims: published-paper SOTA without external protocol mapping
autonomous rollout from initial condition only
same exact inference contract as ups_light_shared_context_transport_guarded CT8
